name: neuronal_cells

phase_0.boundary_condition: cell membrane with ion channels maintaining electrochemical gradient

VINIT.justification: initial state before any neural activity occurs, polarized baseline

TANCH.justification: terminal anchor that terminates depolarization phase and triggers repolarization

AFWD.justification: forward progression of Na+ influx driving membrane potential toward threshold

AREV.justification: reverse flow of K+ restoring resting potential after action potential peak

CLINK.justification: composition of sequential action potentials along axon pathway

IMSCRIB.justification: neuron's ability to recognize its own neurotransmitter patterns for homeostasis

FSPLIT.justification: separates excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic potentials for processing

FFUSE.justification: reconstitutes the split inputs into single action potential decision

EVALT.justification: successful propagation when membrane reaches threshold

EVALF.justification: failed firing when membrane potential doesn't reach activation threshold

ENGAGR.justification: simultaneous presence of both EPSP and IPSP maintaining homeostatic equilibrium

IFIX.justification: long-term potentiation/depression creating irreversible changes in connection strength

phase_3.void_description: electrically neutral primordial state before membrane polarization establishment
phase_3.true_description: membrane potential crossing threshold triggering action potential cascade
phase_3.false_description: membrane potential below firing threshold maintaining resting state
phase_3.both_description: critical state where neuron maintains both active propagation and inhibitory control simultaneously
